about.title: Building Tomorrow's Engineers in the Heart of Jhapa
about.text1: Ganeshman Singh Academy (GMS) is a CTEVT affiliated technical college located in Jhiljhille, Jhapa, Nepal.
about.text2: Each program spans six semesters combining strong theoretical foundations with hands-on, practical training.

programs.it_text: A comprehensive 3-year Diploma program covering computer hardware, software development, networking, database systems, and emerging technologies.
programs.civil_text: A rigorous 3-year Diploma program encompassing structural engineering, surveying, construction management, AutoCAD, and material science.
programs.structure_note: Both diploma programs are affiliated with CTEVT and consist of 6 semesters, each of 6 months.

cta.title: Ready to Start Your Engineering Journey?
cta.text: Contact us for admissions, fee structure, or to learn more about our Diploma programs.

quote.text: The beautiful thing about learning is that nobody can take it away from you.
